$comment: The site's identity. Copy this file to site.json and edit it, or run as-is to use these placeholder values. siteName appears in the header, page titles, and emails. tagline sits beside the wordmark. topic is one phrase naming what the site covers, used in public page copy. domain is the canonical host (SITE_URL env overrides the derived URL). contactEmail is the public inbound address (MAIL_FROM env overrides the outbound From). social handles are optional: empty strings hide the footer icons and the post links. writersPublic (default false) opens the /by writer pages and byline links to visitors once the bylines your feeds produce look right.
